verdict.rationale: Okta ships an official okta-mcp-server (GitHub repo + dedicated blog post) that exposes Okta's Admin Management APIs via MCP, enabling agents to perform actions like creating users, listing failed logins, and auditing unused apps. This is first-party, documented, and confirmed by a probe, though it's admin-API focused rather than a full agent-facing platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the MCP server's real-world reliability and broader community corroboration beyond vendor docs.
